original_question: Let Omega be a smooth strictly pseudoconvex bounded domain in C^n, let varphi belong to C^{1,1}(partial Omega), and let u be the unique plurisubharmonic function on Omega, continuous up to the boundary, with u = varphi on partial Omega and (dd^c u)^n = 0 in Omega. Prove by complex-analytic methods that u is C^{1,1} on Omega.
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper almost verbatim: Ω ⊂ C^n is a smooth strictly pseudoconvex bounded domain, φ ∈ C^{1,1}(∂Ω), u is the unique plurisubharmonic solution continuous up to the boundary with u = φ on ∂Ω and (dd^c u)^n = 0 in Ω, and the requested conclusion is C^{1,1} regularity obtained by complex-analytic methods. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
missing_details: The paper frames this as a methodological open problem: the C^{1,1} regularity statement is already known, and the challenge is to obtain it by complex-analytic methods rather than by Krylov’s probabilistic approach. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

The intended conclusion is interior C^{1,1} regularity in Ω, not an up-to-the-boundary statement on Ω̄; the latter is treated separately in Theorem 3.5 under stronger hypotheses. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

For full stand-alone precision, it is better to write explicitly that u extends continuously to Ω̄ and satisfies u|∂Ω = φ. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

If notation is to be fixed explicitly, define the local complex Monge–Ampère operator by MA(v) = (dd^c v)^n; the paper introduces this notation in the Introduction and §1. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

It is helpful to signal that existence and uniqueness of u are part of the setup of the Dirichlet problem here; the paper’s question is only about proving the regularity by complex-analytic means. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
refined_question: Question 25 (Demailly). Let Ω ⊂ C^n be a smooth strictly pseudoconvex bounded domain, let φ ∈ C^{1,1}(∂Ω), and let u be the unique plurisubharmonic function on Ω that extends continuously to Ω̄, satisfies u|∂Ω = φ, and solves the homogeneous complex Monge–Ampère equation (dd^c u)^n = 0 in Ω. Give a proof, using complex-analytic methods, that u has interior C^{1,1} regularity; equivalently, show that u is C^{1,1} in Ω.
justification: The draft is already extremely close to the official formulation in §3.6. It should be sharpened mainly by making explicit that this is Demailly’s request for a complex-analytic proof of Krylov’s interior C^{1,1} regularity result, and by avoiding drift toward the distinct boundary-regularity statement of Theorem 3.5. The introduction also confirms that §3 is the paper’s regularity section, and the paper’s notation MA(φ) = (dd^cφ)^n underlies the local equation written in your draft. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
